title: Reassembling the componentwise direct-image data
statement: For the coefficient towers in [def-coef-semilinear-system-models], the algebraic inverse images of [lem-coef-ordinary-inverse-system], and the supplied set-sheaf and normalized level adjunctions of [lem-coef-normalized-module-adjunction], there exists a componentwise direct-image datum D with identity-on-sections level component isomorphisms. Its horizontal maps, after forgetting module structures and conjugating by the component isomorphisms and eV, equal uPush of the original horizontal maps. This normalization is part of the existence assertion, without asserting a global Hom bijection or local mate equivalence.

proof.text: Obtain the proved normalized direct-image restriction comparisons by transposing the restricted counit of the inverse-image scalar-restriction comparison.

Apply V at each level of the source strict system and use the restriction comparison to define its transitions. Their underlying maps are the conjugates of uPush of the original transitions. This formula proves the identity and composition laws, and naturality of the comparison proves functoriality on morphisms.

Reassemble by the strict-system/sequence-site equivalence. Its evaluation comparison is identity on section carriers. The section formula for the reassembled transitions proves the asserted horizontal normalization.

theorem ordinaryDirectSystem_core_data_exists [PreservesFiniteLimits uInv]
    (hI : ∀ n,
      uInv.map ((sheafCompose J (CategoryTheory.forget CommRingCat.{max c v r})).map (τ n)) ≫
          (I n).ringUnderlying.hom =
        (I (n + 1)).ringUnderlying.hom ≫
          (sheafCompose J' (CategoryTheory.forget CommRingCat.{max c v r})).map (σ n))
    (uPush : Sheaf J' (Type (max c v r)) ⥤ Sheaf J (Type (max c v r)))
    (adjSet : uInv ⊣ uPush)
    (eV : ∀ n, V n ⋙ underlying.{c, v, r} J (B n) ≅
      underlying.{c, v, r} J' (F n) ⋙ uPush)
    (ha : ∀ n (M : Mod.{c, v, max c v r} J (B n))
      (N : Mod.{c, v, max c v r} J' (F n)) (f : (I n).modules.obj M ⟶ N),
      (underlying.{c, v, r} J (B n)).map ((a n).homEquiv M N f) ≫ (eV n).hom.app N =
        adjSet.homEquiv _ _ ((I n).moduleUnderlying.inv.app M ≫
          (underlying.{c, v, r} J' (F n)).map f)) :
    ∃ D : OrdinaryDirectSystemCoreData.{c, v, r} (J := J) (B := B) (τ := τ)
        (J' := J') (F := F) (σ := σ) (V := V),
      OrdinaryDirectSystemCoreNormalized.{c, v, r} J B τ J' F σ V D uPush eV
